joinFrom: You can join from 10 minutes before the start.
checkIntro: The patient will see and hear you once you join.
noSound: No sound detected. Check that your microphone is on and not muted.
cameraDenied: Your browser is not allowing the camera. Allow it in the site settings, then reload the page. You can still join without video.
microphoneDenied: Your browser is not allowing the microphone. Allow it in the site settings, then reload the page. Without it, the patient cannot hear you.
peerLeft: {name} has left the consultation. They can join again until the consultation ends.

peerWithdrewConsent.defaultMessage: The patient withdrew consent for this clinic, so the consultation has ended.

cancelled.defaultMessage: This appointment was cancelled, so the consultation has ended.

endFulfilled: The patient will be disconnected and cannot join again. The appointment will be marked as fulfilled.
endNoShow: The patient has not joined. The appointment will be marked as a no-show.
left: You left the consultation. You can join again until it ends.
otherTab: The consultation is open in another tab or window.
notRestored: The connection could not be restored.
markedFulfilled: The appointment is marked as fulfilled.
markedNoShow: The appointment is marked as a no-show.
timeLimit: The consultation reached its time limit and has ended.
windowNotOpen: This consultation opens 10 minutes before the start.

consentRequired.defaultMessage: The patient's consent for this clinic is not active, so the consultation cannot take place.

notStarted: You have not joined this consultation yet, so there is nothing to end.
cannotConnect: The video connection could not be started. Check your connection and try again.
title: Consultation
timePassed: The time to join this consultation has passed.
